integrity.claim_scope: TR-BDF2 endpoint nonnegativity on directed cycles with n>=2

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the endpoint map for unit-rate homogeneous directed cycles and does not assert stagewise positivity, or positivity for arbitrary Markov generators.
The general root formulas are exact implicit polynomial boundaries; displayed decimals are illustrative.
Literature comparisons cannot rule out an overlooked specialized earlier equivalent formulation.
Finite verifier checks supplement rather than replace the quantified proof.
title: Sharp five-state positivity barrier and reentrant timestep window for TR-BDF2 on directed cycles
